editorial:
Imagine living with your ex and his new girlfriend while they plan their engagement. That is the nightmare your main character is facing, and you will be rooting for her from the first minute. She takes a job as a set decorator for a grumpy, famous chef to get some space and a fresh start. The vibe is super cozy and festive, making it the perfect movie to put on when you just want to relax and smile. You get a great mix of awkward comedy and sweet romantic moments as the two leads go from hating each other to falling in love while building a holiday wonderland.

The chemistry between the actors feels real, and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling too slow. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the funny dialogue makes up for it. You should definitely watch this if you love holiday movies that feel like a warm hug. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the sparkly decorations, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head on New Year's Eve. The main character finally packs her bags and leaves her ex for good, just as he is about to propose to his girlfriend. The celebrity chef realizes he is in love and surprises her at the pop-up event with a romantic gesture. They kiss under the mistletoe, and he promises to support her career. It is a happy ending where everyone finds where they truly belong.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy holiday rom-coms and happy endings.
